lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate veechaaree sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||8||18||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal sabad niramal hai baanee ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad is Immaculate and Pure; the Bani of the Word is Pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal jot sabh maahi samaanee ||
lines.translation: The Light which is pervading among all is Immaculate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: niramal baanee har saalaahee jap har niramal mail gavaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: So praise the Immaculate Word of the Lord's Bani; chanting the Immaculate Name of the Lord, all filth is washed away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sukhadaataa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har niramal gur sabad salaahee sabado sun tisaa mitaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Praise the Immaculate Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Listen to the Shabad, and quench your thirst. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal naam vasiaa man aae ||
lines.translation: When the Immaculate Naam comes to dwell in the mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan niramal maaiaa mohu gavaae ||
lines.translation: the mind and body become Immaculate, and emotional attachment to Maya departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: niramal gun gaavai nit saache ke niramal naad vajaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate True Lord forever, and the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad shall vibrate within. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal a(n)mrit gur te paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Ambrosial Nectar is obtained from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap muaa tithai mohu na maaiaa ||
lines.translation: When selfishness and conceit are eradicated from within, then there is no attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: niramal giaan dhiaan at niramal niramal baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Immaculate is the spiritual wisdom, and utterly immaculate is the meditation, of those whose minds are filled with the Immaculate Bani of the Word. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo niramal seve s niramal hovai ||
lines.translation: One who serves the Immaculate Lord becomes immaculate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mail gurasabade dhovai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the filth of egotism is washed away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: niramal vaajai anahad dhun baanee dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Bani and the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current vibrate, and in the True Court, honor is obtained. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal te sabh niramal hovai ||
lines.translation: Through the Immaculate Lord, all become immaculate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal manooaa har sabad parovai ||
lines.translation: Immaculate is the mind which weaves the Word of the Lord's Shabad into itself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: niramal naam lage badabhaagee niramal naam suhaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Blessed and very fortunate are those who are committed to the Immaculate Name; through the Immaculate Name, they are blessed and beautified. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so niramal jo sabade sohai ||
lines.translation: Immaculate is the one who is adorned with the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal naam man tan mohai ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices the mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam mal kade na laagai mukh oojal sach karaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: No filth ever attaches itself to the True Name; one's face is made radiant by the True One. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mailaa hai doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: The mind is polluted by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਮੈਲੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mailaa chaukaa mailai thaai ||
lines.translation: Filthy is that kitchen, and filthy is that dwelling;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mailaa khaai phir mail vadhaae manamukh mail dukh paavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: eating filth, the self-willed manmukhs become even more filthy. Because of their filth, they suffer in pain. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: maile niramal sabh hukam sabaae ||
lines.translation: The filthy, and the immaculate as well, are all subject to the Hukam of God's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se niramal jo har saache bhaae ||
lines.translation: They alone are immaculate, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar guramukh mail chukaavaniaa ||8||19||20||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam abides deep within the minds of the Gurmukhs, who are cleansed of all their filth. ||8||19||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: govi(n)d oojal oojal ha(n)saa ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is radiant, and radiant are His soul-swans.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man baanee niramal meree manasaa ||
lines.translation: Their minds and their speech are immaculate; they are my hope and ideal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man oojal sadaa mukh sohahi at oojal naam dhiaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Their minds are radiant, and their faces are always beautiful; they meditate on the most radiant Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gobi(n)d gun gaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobid gobid kahai din raatee gobid gun sabad sunaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: So chant Gobind, Gobind, the Lord of the Universe, day and night; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind, through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobid gaavahi sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: Sing of the Lord Gobind with intuitive ease,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhai oojal haumai mal jaae ||
lines.translation: in the Fear of the Guru; you shall become radiant, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahahi bhagat karahi din raatee sun gobid gun gaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Remain in bliss forever, and perform devotional worship, day and night. Hear and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa naachai bhagat driRaae ||
lines.translation: Channel your dancing mind in devotional worship,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad manai man milaae ||
lines.translation: and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, merge your mind with the Supreme Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਤਾਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa taal poore maaiaa mohu chukaae sabade nirat karaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Let your true and perfect tune be the subjugation of your love of Maya, and let yourself dance to the Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਨਹਿ ਪਛਾੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oochaa kooke tanahi pachhaaRe ||
lines.translation: People shout out loud and move their bodies,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohi johiaa jamakaale ||
lines.translation: but if they are emotionally attached to Maya, then the Messenger of Death shall hunt them down.
